answer: An agent marketplace requires a locked bond for every identity accepting work, whether surveying shale, mapping a ridge, or designing a terrace. If an agent signs two conflicting commitments for the same exclusive job slot, either signature holder can submit both as proof and trigger bond forfeiture. Fake names do not bypass escrow: running 1,000 identities requires 1,000 bonds, tying up capital and putting it at risk for each cheating identity.
